name: MA-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Jake Auchincloss running with a large financial advantage
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~97%
model.rationale: Auchincloss holds a D+11 district with over $7 million on hand against a challenger who has raised about $26,000, and markets price his reelection near certainty. Fundamentals point to a roughly 22-point Democratic margin with no evidence of a competitive race.
model.watch: Any late surge in outside spending against Auchincloss or a credible poll showing a single-digit race would warrant a relook.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Jake Auchincloss seeks another term in a Massachusetts district that leans about 11 points Democratic, and he enters the general election with a decisive financial edge: roughly $7.3 million on hand after raising over $3.6 million, versus about $1,300 for Republican Thomas Stalcup, who has raised only around $26,000. No outside groups are opposing the incumbent.

With no public polls or expert ratings available, the race rests on fundamentals, which point to a comfortable Democratic margin of about 22 points. Prediction markets price a Democratic win at roughly 97%, consistent with a Safe D rating.
